real_defects.issue: checkCfdi threw a TypeError (VIGENCIA[fr][0] on undefined) for any Comercio Exterior 2.0 CFDI dated before 2024-01-18 whose FraccionArancelaria has no VIGENCIA entry (e.g. 7801100100), so the user got no report at all. Fixed with fraccionVigencia(code) supplying the default range; test 'a CFDI dated before CCE 2.0 names the code's start date instead of throwing'.
